extension.description: Library Watchdog will watch your media sources for changes and automatically update the library when new files are added or removed. Update is instant.
extension.news:
v1.2.0 - Fix bug in self.supported_media that was erroneously matching media with files that had no extension and folders. - Fix issues with oudated python code in main (break being called in a finally block) - New feature to monitor the Kodi library media file deletion action and delete the related files (.edl, .xml,.map etc) - Also added an option to delete the parent folder that the media was contained in. - Deleted some obsolete code such as the script extension point (not used) - Reformed settings.xml to use the modern Kodi format. - Code verification to work in Piers.
v1.1.3 - Fix compatibility with Kodi 21: - Add locking for xbmcvfs calls: walk VFS sources iteratively instead of via recursive generator delegation and stop when another library scan/clean is running - Fix crash when watching a network share (smb/nfs): skip cases where xbmcvfs.listdir() returns a filename with lone surrogate codepoints - Add future support for newer releases of watchdog: use stdlib threading.Event instead of the removed watchdog.utils.compat.Event, and pass recursive/timeout as keyword arguments
v1.1.2 - Support json.loads for both less python 3.9 and newer
v1.1.1 - Fix monitor class being used incorrectly so addon can start
v1.1.0 - Update dependencies - Enable virtual filesystems nby fixing py3 unicode issues - Update abortRequested() API calls
v1.0.0 - Remove script.module.pathtools and script.module.watchdog so they are correctly referenced upstream
v0.9.8 - convert addon to work on py3
v0.9.7 - increased number of possible custom sources to 10
